people.name: Bethany
people.line: Village near Jerusalem, home of Mary, Martha, and Lazarus.

translations.web: The next day, when they had come out from Bethany, he was hungry.
translations.bsb: The next day, when they had left Bethany, Jesus was hungry.
translations.kjv: And on the morrow, when they were come from Bethany, he was hungry:
